acquisition: Operator-supplied exact resources only; no automatic download.
contig_policy: Exact FASTA/FAI order and RefSeq accession/version names. Identity-only aliases; no reordering, subsets or chr-style alias substitution.
disable_path: Do not select this profile; missing or mismatched resources refuse before native alignment.
index_sidecars: Only the five pinned suffixes are accepted; implicit alternative sidecars are refused.
